programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Larry wants to drive his1959 Cadillac DeVille, but the car has spent decades baking in the Arizona sun. Brian spent years gathering parts to restore his grandfather’s 1960 Bel Air only to find that he’s missing more critical components than he’s found…

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: At FantomWorks, there are 85 cars being worked on and multiple owners who expect miracles. From a vintage motorcycle to getting a 1970 GTO ready for a returning vet, Dan burns the midnight oil to get cars out the door so new arrivals can take their place.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Jerry shows up with a car in pieces, a U-Haul full of parts and a dream of a perfect Plymouth Business Coupe that desperately needs Dan’s help. Bill asks Dan to find him a 1972 Gran Sport and to restore it with hard-to-find features.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: The 63 Z06 is getting more fiber glass work done on the inside. Vinnie is working on replacing the windows on the 442 and putting the guts in the door. Plus, we head to Galveston for the Galveston Corvette Show.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and Jan are visiting Mecum Auctions in Houston, Texas checking out some of the coolest classic muscle cars about to hit the auction block!

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Michael wants a new convertible top for his 1953 Morgan, but the Fantomworks team has no reference, no template and no anchor points. Butch entrusted his 1969 Camaro to a restoration rip-off artist. Can Fantomworks fix the worst work they’ve ever seen?

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team are getting the sound system ready inside the 1969 Mustang Malicious Intent. The 1950 Ford has miles of wiring to install.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: FantomWorks epic 4 year long wrestling match with the 1961 International Harvester Metro concludes with an incredible, one-of-a-kind van. Ray wants his 1969 ZL1 to match the number 68 rally car, but he needs Dan’s rare Winters stamped 427 COPO motor.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team are looking at a custom LS3 motor . The 1960 Corvette is getting work done on its brake pads.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie is in Scottsdale Arizona for Barrett Jackson 2024. There is so much happening, from checking out awesome vendors, looking at awesome classic cars, and even trying amazing food.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie heads to West Texas to pick up a cool car to be serviced. Street Dreams has a shop full of unique classic muscle cars that you have to check out!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: Dude, Where's Allysa's Car?
programme.desc: A new season of Graveyard Carz, the show wherein abandoned and left­for­death classic Mopars are given a new lease on life.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Chris asks FantomWorks to breathe new life into a 1951 Mercury Woody that was sitting in a chicken coop for thirty years. Dan’s 1970 Mustang Boss arrives with a long list of problems and the speed of a sea slug.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: Will Gets Grumpy
programme.desc: A new season of Graveyard Carz, the show wherein abandoned and left­for­death classic Mopars are given a new lease on life.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Mike wants Dan to make his prized Mach 1 even more of a muscle car. Richard brings FantomWorks the first ‘his and hers’ restoration – a Sunbeam Tiger and a Fiat Spider – but as Dan soon discovers; the challenges of the two cars are not equal.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas are working in the paint booth on the Malicious Intent. The 1966 Mustang is sanding out the car to get it ready for the paint booth. The 86 Camaro is being converted into a sniper system under the hood.

programme.title: The Ride Life
programme.desc: Despite a troubled past of poverty and invasions, Korea has emerged as a car building power-house. Through its unheralded and talented-loaded car scene, Sung reconnects with the land of his birth and finds peace with his estranged mother.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: Cuda 'Tat
programme.desc: The world is littered with the remains of forgotten muscle cars. At Graveyard Carz, some will get a second chance in the hands of Mark Worman and the Ghouls.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Emmett believes his 1964 Barracuda is all original. But Dan finds out that the car has hidden damage and a past that nobody expected. Velvet wants Dan to get her 1953 Studebaker Commander running as a surprise for her husband, Travis.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Mike’s 1939 Hudson Coupe-Convertible is the only survivor of three that were built. He wants Fantomworks to restore it to original condition – even though nobody knows what that looks like. Jim wants his 1970 Nova to be the ultimate dragster.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas install airbags on the 48 Dodge. Team gets ready for the Galveston Classic Car show.

programme.title: The Ride Life
programme.desc: Sung's dive into the world's car cultures takes him to Poland, a country that emerged from a repressive communist era. Sung finds that new freedoms have led to an explosion of optimist and energy, and one of the most exciting experiences of his life.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Karen blir sendt på sykehuset i all hast når fødselen starter. Etter at Sean truer Leslie, forteller hun Dex hvem Sean egentlig er.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis advarer Blake om Seans sanne identitet. Blake blir bekymret for familiens sikkerhet og drar til Natumbre sammen med Dex for å avdekke Seans mystiske plan vedrørende Vitron-avtalen.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Etter eksplosjonen i Natumbre blir Blake anklaget for ulovlig våpenhandel. Alexis finner bevis på at Sean betalte Jesse for å komme tilbake til Denver, for at han skulle overtale Karen til å beholde Adams baby.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Dana prøver desperat å overbevise Adam om hvor inderlig hun vil ha sønnen deres. Hun foreslår at hvis de fremstår som et sammensveiset par igjen, vil dommeren dømme i deres favør.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Adam blir fritatt for mistanke om at han har kidnappet sønnen sin når Leslie forteller ham at Sean har tatt babyen og holder henne fanget.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Etter Seans død, finner Alexis trøst i Dex' vennskap, og de blåser liv i lidenskapen igjen.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Sammy Jo og Jeff blir lettet når de finner ut at liket som oppdages i vannet ikke er Krystle.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake nyter tiden sammen med Krystle i Dayton, og er fortsatt forvirret over hukommelsessvikten hennes, og frykter at det skal skje igjen.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake gir Jeff en tredel av kontrollen i Denver-Carrington, og utsetter Adams planer om å ta full kontroll over selskapet.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis mistenker at regnskapsføreren har samarbeidet med Sean for å ruinere Colbyco, og innser at hun kan miste imperiet sitt. Sammy Jo finner ut at Jeff kysset Fallon.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystle er omgitt av de hun elsker og bestemmer seg for å leve. Fallon tar bildet av Blake og den døde mannen med på likhuset, uvitende om at hun blir observert.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Dex tolker Alexis' vendetta mot Blake som et kjærlighets-/hatforhold, og forteller Alexis at han har fått nok av å bli tatt for gitt.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystle går med på operasjon, men først etter at Blake signerer skilsmissepapirene og livstestamentet, som skal settes i live hvis operasjonen mislykkes.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystles operasjon mislykkes, og hun havner i koma. Da Blake blir fortalt at hun sannsynligvis ikke vil våkne, vender han hjem til Denver i sorg. Sammy Jo blir overfalt av en ukjent person.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake frykter at hans mørke hemmelighet vil bli avslørt pga. letingen etter Roger Grimes' morder, og bestemmer seg for å ta støyten for å få en slutt på etterforskningen. Dex og Sable er begge ute etter Heath.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Sammy Jo gjenkjenner Gibson som mannen Krystle så i marerittene sine, og Blake sverger på å beskytte familiehemmeligheten med sitt liv. Adam finner ut om Virginias hemmelige fortid.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis hyrer en leiesoldat for å få skipene tilbake. Adam og Jeff slåss når Jeff påstår at Adam er illojal overfor Blake. Dex begynner å tvile på at Alexis noen gang kan tilby ham kjærligheten han trenger.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Sable prøver å overbevise Blake om at hun er på hans side. Dex blir tiltrukket av lojaliteten hennes. Sammy Jo blir stadig mer interessert i Tanner McBride. Dex angriper Adam når han hører at han utnyttet Virginia.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Sable overtaler Heath til å ikke drepe henne. Etter den rystende hendelsen finner hun trøst hos Dex. Alexis drar til Paris for å holde øye med Boyds kommandooperasjon.

programme.desc: Tom and Diana search for someone who is kidnapping young 4400s. Shawn is threatened by the Nova Group.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: With Dennis Ryland's help, NTAC tracks down the remaining members of the Nova Group. Nikki pays Shawn an unexpected visit.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana are drugged with a hallucinogen, which was created from an oil secreted from the hands of a 4400.

programme.title: The 4400

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana's investigation into a series of gruesome murders leads them to uncover another conspiracy within the government. At the 4400 Center, Shawn receives a gift from another returnee that allows him to see his future.

programme.title: The 4400

programme.title: The 4400

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana continue their investigation on Jordan Collier's plan for mankind. Dennis Ryland returns to NTAC. Isabelle is seriously injured when she takes a classroom hostage.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A high school student develops an ability after injecting promicin. Tom visits Isabelle in jail, while Diana searches for her missing sister. Following the advice of a young woman named Cassie, Kyle is able to wake Shawn from his coma.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana search for a person who has the ability to make people's worst fears come to life. Danny seeks Shawn's help in finding a promicin shot. Cassie leads Kyle to a book that contains a prophecy about Jordan Collier.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Audrey Parker develops the ability to astral project herself. However, after she is murdered, Audrey attempts to use her ability to lead Tom and Diana to her killer.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: April's new ability endangers her life. Shawn is approached to run for public office, while Kyle helps Isabelle.

programme.desc: After realizing Tom knows he is promicin-positive, Kyle joins Jordan in a remote town called Evanston. Tom follows Kyle, and learns the remarkable truth about Evanston: all of its residents are promicin-positive.

programme.desc: Richie & Santanico pose as sex traffickers to infiltrate Malvado's food supply. Sonja forces Seth to kick a habit. Freddie faces Sex Machine, who attacks his family to retrieve the codex.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: Hidden in County Wicklow's woods, this eerie Irish sculpture park features massive black granite statues exploring birth, death, and the darker sides of the human mind. Designed for adult reflection, every figure tells a deeply thought-provoking story.

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring one of the world’s most amazing abandoned theme parks in China, built to rival Disney but abandoned after going bankrupt just a few years later.

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: In Japan's Fukushima radiation zone, urban explorers document abandoned JDM cars left since the 2011 nuclear disaster. Geiger counter in hand, they discover rare models including an R32 GTR and an Evo VII frozen in time.

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned 5-star casino hotel in Macau, once closed by the government over safety issues and rumored crime, now left as a haunting time capsule.

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: Cranebank near Heathrow trained thousands of British Airways staff from the 1960s until 2021, now abandoned as a haunting aviation relic.
programme.sub-title: The Abandoned London Airport Terminal: 747 Planes Parked Forever (Shocking Discovery)

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: A cancelled China road trip leads to exploring an abandoned luxury villa park with pools, saunas, a cinema, and lavish interiors slowly reclaimed by nature.

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: Inside an abandoned Fukushima house and store, explorers uncover rare Japanese gaming memorabilia and toys untouched since the 2011 nuclear disaster. Rising radiation levels and structural hazards add danger to every step.

programme.title: Steve Ronin
programme.desc: Steve explores Taiwan’s abandoned UFO Village, a bizarre ghost town filled with futuristic homes that look straight out of another world.

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: Silver City Galleria was a large Taunton, MA mall with 120 stores and many amenities. It served the region and was demolished in 2021.

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: Deep in Fukushima's red zone, explorers discover an untouched high-end tuxedo shop and jewelry store, finding hundreds of abandoned suits worth £500, £1000 each, watches, and gems left behind since the 2011 disaster.

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: A billionaire heir inherited a 15,000 sq ft mansion and luxury cars. After losing his wife, he hoarded until his death, leaving it frozen in time.
programme.sub-title: Almost Robbed In Abandoned Mansion (Millions of Dollars and Cars Left Behind)

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: Explorers visit a uniquely surreal abandoned house whose entire front façade has collapsed, exposing the interior like a doll's house. The adventure takes an unexpected turn when local farmers arrive and start firing a shotgun in the garden.

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned top secret Titan I missile silo in Colorado, one of six built during the Cold War when nuclear missiles stood ready for launch.
programme.sub-title: Secret Titan I Missile Silo of the United States

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: In Scotland, Dan venture through a vast, decaying Victorian psychiatric hospital. Untouched patient rooms and medical equipment lie abandoned. The team uncovers dark histories of overcrowding and mistreatment, while hunting for paranormal activity.

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned car factory in Sicily where Fiat Panda, Punto, 500 and Lancia Ypsilon were built, closed in 2011 and now planned for reindustrialization.
programme.sub-title: Exploring a Complete Intact Abandoned Car Factory

programme.title: Steve Ronin
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned property once sold to become a horse preserve, left undeveloped for years, with stories of its former owners adding mystery.
programme.sub-title: This Abandoned Mansion Still Had Jewelry Locked Inside

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: Dan enters a long-abandoned hospital deep in Japan's Fukushima Red Zone. Overgrown paths and radiation fears set an uneasy tone as the team investigates the eerie site, encountering unexplained noises along the way.

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: Formosa Fun Coast in Taiwan closed after a 2015 color powder fire killed 15 and injured 508. The park has been abandoned ever since.
programme.sub-title: The Accident That Shocked the World - Abandoned Water Park Disaster

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned luxury hotel near Dubai, once built as a palace for Abu Dhabi rulers, closed since 2016 and now frozen in time.
programme.sub-title: Discovered an Abandoned Luxury Hotel in Dubai

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: Greeks Play Land, built in 1970 by The Greek for handicapped children using repurposed materials, was free to all but closed after his death due to lack of upkeep.

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring abandoned military sites in France and Kuwait, from a NATO airbase with Soviet gear to Saddam Husseins vehicle graveyard on Failaka Island.
programme.sub-title: Abandoned Armies: Soviet Tanks & Saddam’s Rusting War Machines

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring Colorado’s abandoned mining sites and the forbidden ghost town of Gilman, closed in 1984 by the EPA due to toxic pollution.

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: An episode exploring abandoned Fukushima shops left intact and a highly contaminated car graveyard, showing rarely seen, previously undocumented sites.
programme.sub-title: The Radiation Ghost Mall inside Japan's Abandoned City (Highly Contaminated)

programme.title: Kill, Baby Kill!
programme.desc: En fjellby hjemsøkes av et gjenferd i form av en liten morderisk jente, noe som får en rettsmedisiner og en medisinstudent til å forsøke å avsløre hennes hemmeligheter, mens en heks bruker sine kunster for å beskytte landsbyboerne.

programme.title: Summer of Fear
programme.desc: En tenårings liv rakner når hennes mystiske kusine flytter inn etter en tragedie. Merkelige hendelser eskalerer, og hun aner mørke krefter. Når ingen tror henne, må hun avsløre sannheten før ondskapen tar over.

programme.title: The Raven
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: Dark Star NO
programme.desc: Det er midten av 2000-tallet, og mennesket har utforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forlatt jorden for å finne nye hjem i universet. Det væpnede romskipet "Dark Star" skal bane vei for alle de fredelige kolonistene.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A Belize police superintendent is found dead in the water, shot with his own gun. The only witness? A Canadian socialite with ties to one of the country's most powerful families. Her story didn't add up.
programme.sub-title: MURDER OR ACCIDENT? The Devastating Case of Henry Jemmott and Jasmine Hartin

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: When Mengqi Ji vanished, her husband claimed she walked out on him. But cell phone data, muddy boots, and a juniper tree in a state park told a very different story. A solved true crime case about control, lies, and justice.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Tragic Case of Mengqi Ji

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1991, 19-year-old aspiring actress Heather Stigliano was beaten and stabbed to death in her Myrtle Beach apartment during a robbery. James Whipple was caught weeks later and confessed, saying he killed her for drug money.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook

programme.title: Temptation Island USA

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: En ny twist får ting til å skje i begge villaene. Great og Nafeesah tar forholdet sitt til neste nivå. Hall kommer til en livsendrende konklusjon. Marisela gjenoppdager seg selv da skyldfølelsen begynner å sette inn for Paris.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA

programme.title: Temptation Island USA

programme.title: Temptation Island USA

programme.title: Temptation Island USA

programme.title: Temptation Island USA

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Parene og de single vender tilbake til en dramatisk gjenforening på 90 minutter etter tiden på øya.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: ire nye par tar en reise til Temptation Island for å se om forholdet deres tåler alt.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Singlene flytter inn, og det går vilt for seg. Det første «bålet» byr på smertefulle oppvåkninger.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Noen par begynner å nyte sin nyvunnede uavhengighet, mens andre forblir fast i fortiden.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Mark kommer med en uventet vending under elimineringen, noe som ryster deltakerne i begge villaene.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA

programme.title: Temptation Island USA

programme.title: Temptation Island USA

programme.title: Temptation Island USA

programme.title: Andromeda: Phear Phactor Phenom

programme.title: Andromeda: Änglarnas förfall

programme.title: Andromeda: Eskatologin i vår nutid
programme.desc: Beka vinner ett pris från en radio-DJ, får reda på sanningen om Seefra och hittar Meethusdiagrammet.

programme.title: Andromeda: När det går runt...
programme.desc: En vetenskapsman från det ursprungliga samväldet dyker upp, fångad i en tidsloop.

programme.title: Andromeda: Försök med screed
programme.desc: Flavin återvänder och utlöser ett gängkrig och hjälper Dylan att utvecklas som Paradine.

programme.title: Andromeda: Så bränn de otämnda länderna
programme.desc: En kristall som kan återställa Andromedas kraft upptäcks, men för att få tag på den måste Dylan arbeta för gruvans ägare.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det som kommer att bli var inte
programme.desc: Tunnlar upptäcks på Seefra som kan användas för att nå åtta andra Seefra-planeter.
programme.sub-title: Det som kommer att bli var inte

programme.title: Andromeda: Testet
programme.desc: När en gammal man mördas är Beka, Rhade och Harper huvudmisstänkta och ställs inför rättegång.

programme.title: Andromeda: Genom ett mörkt glas
programme.desc: Rhade leder rebellerna i strid mot en krigsherre på Seefra-5.

programme.title: Andromeda: Stolthet före det fall
programme.desc: Dylan upptäcker att Bekkas pojkvän egentligen var Drago Musevini och att han använde Bekkas DNA för att skapa Nietzscheanerna.

programme.title: Andromeda: Månskenet blir till dig
programme.desc: Beka och Rhade hittar ett prov som antingen kommer att ge dem stora rikedomar eller driva dem till vansinne.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det förflutna är prolix
programme.desc: Harper upptäcker ett program som kan förstöra åtta av Seefras planeter och döda miljontals människor.

programme.title: Andromeda: Attraktionens motsatser
programme.desc: Medan Harper arbetar på ett sätt att rädda Seefra-systemet smyger en spion ombord på Andromeda och attackerar Beka.

programme.title: Andromeda: Att rädda ljuset från en svart sol
programme.desc: Ett försök görs att fixa Seefras blinkande sol, men Trance ersätts av en dubbelgångare.
programme.sub-title: Att rädda ljuset från en svart sol

programme.title: Andromeda: Total återkallelse
programme.desc: När Dylan skadas svårt i en explosion i ett labb reser han genom en rad alternativa verkligheter.

programme.title: Andromeda: Kvant-traktat delirium
programme.desc: Rommie byggs om för att hjälpa till att evakuera Seefra-systemet.

programme.title: Andromeda: En dag till i ljuset
programme.desc: En krigsherre övertygar sina anhängare om att den annalkande förstörelsen av de yttre planeterna är en komplott för att göra det lättare att plundra deras planet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Kaos och dess stillhet
programme.desc: Dylan, Rhade och Beka arbetar tillsammans för att rädda Trance från Methus-2 och Harper från general Burma.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Killen Som Älskar Grupparbete
programme.desc: Phoebe går med i den coola gruppen i ett skolarbete, men upptäcker att de inte vill jobba lika hårt som hon. Max tar Phoebes vanliga plats i hennes vänners grupp för att försöka åka snålskjuts medan de andra gör allt arbete.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Superbarnvakterna
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max verkar vara två vanliga tonårstvillingar, men de tillhör en familj superhjältar. Phoebe strävar efter att vara normal och använder sina krafter för att göra gott, men Max väljer den mörka sidan. Kan livet bli normalt för familjen?

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Middagsbjudning
programme.desc: Max planerar att sabotera middagen när Phoebe bjuder hem killen hon är kär i och hans familj för att imponera på dem, men när en oväntad gäst dyker upp måste Phoebe och Max samarbeta för att förhindra att kvällen förvandlas till en katastrof.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Betyg
programme.desc: Efter att ha ändrat sina betyg och flyttats upp till avancerad matte, får Max tävla mot Phoebe i 'Matteduellen'. Samtidigt försöker Hank, Nora och Billy att fånga den gäckande tidningstjuven.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Phoebe mot Max
programme.desc: När Max utsätter Phoebe för ett practical joke när de ska ta skolfoton utbryter ett practical joke-krig mellan dem som går överstyr. Samtidigt försöker sig Hank och Barb på en ny uppfostringsmodell för att få Billy och Nora att hjälpa till hemma.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Knäpp Teknikmässa
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max låter sin gamla rivalitet blossa upp när de hjälper Billy och Nora med deras projekt för skolan teknikmässa. Under tiden försöker Barb ta Hank på bar gärning efter att han har kopierat hennes anteckningar för bokklubben.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Helggästen
programme.desc: Phoebe har anmält sig som frivillig för att ta hand om klassens Flugfälla över helgen, men när Max utför experiment på den, börjar den växa och hotar till slut att ta över hela huset.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Skolkdagen
programme.desc: Max och Phoebe använder sina krafter för att roa sig under Skolkdagen, men när de kommer på att det finns övervakningskameror på skolan tar de hjälp av Billy och Nora för att radera filmerna innan hemligheten avslöjas.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Phoebe är en Klon Nu
programme.desc: Efter att Phoebe tagit på sig alldeles för många aktiviteter, hjälper Max till genom att skapa en klon så att hon kan vara på två ställen samtidigt. När klonen börjar ställa till det för den riktiga Phoebe måste Max hjälpa till att rädda henes rykte.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Det här ser ut att vara ett job för
programme.desc: Max och Phoebe tar jobb på en pizzarestaurang för att få råd att köpa den nya mePhonen, och var för sig försöker de imponera på chefen med egna idéer. När Max tar på sig en för stor beställning måste de samarbeta för att rädda sina jobb.
programme.sub-title: Det här ser ut att vara ett job för

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Bli Knasig
programme.desc: En komet gör att Thundermans krafter blir knasiga samtidigt som killen Phoebe är kär i bjuder henne på skoldansen. Phoebe och Max får veta att om de håller ihop kan de hålla sina krafter i styr, men ingen är speciellt glad för att ha den andra nära.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Objudna Restauranggäster
programme.desc: När ungarna råkar krascha presenten som Hank köpt till Barb på deras bröllopsdag, måste de ta hjälp av Blobbin, en vän till familjen och superhjältemedhjälpare, för att laga den och se till att deras föräldrar inte får reda på nåt.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Brott Efter Brott
programme.desc: Hank bildar en brottsbekämpningsförening i grannskapet när det börjar begås brott. Max tar på sig skulden för brotten för att dölja sin egen hemlighet, men Phoebe vet att han är oskyldig och det är upp till familjen att fånga den verkliga brottslingen.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Du Stal Min Dröm, Brorsan
programme.desc: När Max vinner skolvalet som Phoebe hade jobbat så hårt för, planerar hon sin hämnd.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Thundersinne
programme.desc: Phoebe får förmågan att ana fara innan den har hänt, och använder sitt nyfunna sinne för att imponera på sina klasskamrater. Under tiden låtsas Max att han inte har fått sitt sinne ännu för att få presenter av Barb.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Ha en Cool Födelsedag
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max vill få lov att hålla ett födelsedagsparty som normala tonåringar, men när en nedfryst fru Wong kommer bort och dom måste hitta henne, inser de hur bra deras familjepartyn faktiskt är.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Upp, upp och semester!
programme.desc: Familjen Thunderman deltar i en familjetävling för att vinna en drömsemester, men de har olika idéer om vart de ska åka. När de inte kan enas deltar de som två skilda lag, killar mot tjejer, och så får vinnaren bestämma.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Inget är som ett pyjamasparty
programme.desc: Phoebe håller sitt första pyjamasparty och använder psykokinesi för att rädda det från att bli en katastrof. Som bestraffning måste hon ha på sig ett ankelband som hindrar henne från att använda sina krafter, så hon ber Max om hjälp.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Små Vita Körer
programme.desc: När en elak tjej vid namn Veronica saboterar för Phoebe i kören och utnyttjar Max genom att få honom att göra hennes läxor, samarbetar tvillingarna för att ta hämnd på henne.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Kalla Doktorerna Thunderman
programme.desc: Max och Phoebe passar Billy och får ta honom till sjukhus när han skadar tummen. Efter att Max sett en nål och svimmat, måste de allihop se till att doktorerna inte ser röntgenbilderna av hans hjärna, för då kan hans superkrafter avslöjas.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Kemi är Magi
programme.desc: Hank blir Max och Phoebes nya kemilärare. När han av en olyckshändelse äter kalkonmackor som får honom att somna så måste tvillingarna använda sina krafter för att hjälpa honom genomföra en presentation och behålla sitt jobb.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Fyra Superhjältar och en Bebis
programme.desc: Phoebe släpar med Billy och Nora till parken för att träffa killen hon är kär i och hans lilla lillebror, men när Max kommer för att hämta sina syskon tar han av misstag den riktiga bebisen i stället för Noras docka.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Fult Spel i Hejaklacken
programme.desc: Phoebe och Cherrys vänskap sätts på prov när bara en av dem blir uttagen till cheerleader-laget. Max vinner en tävling där priset är en månads gratis pizza, och måste övertyga sin familj att han inte fuskade.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Thunder-Van
programme.desc: Hank tar hem familjens Thunder-Van från Metroburg för att Phoebe ska kunna fortsätta sin superhjälteträning. När alla fyra barnen smyger sig in i bilen för att utan lov ta en tur ger Hank dem en åktur de aldrig kommer att glömma.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Konsten att Sälja Konst
programme.desc: Phoebe får hjälp av Billy med ett konstprojekt, men får veta att han stulit föremålet från ett museum. Nu måste de samarbeta med Max för att ta sig in och lämna tillbaka det innan någon märker det.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Max hejdukar
programme.desc: Max låter några yngre elever bli hans hejdukar, men när de vänder på situationen och gör honom till offer för ett förödmjukande skämt, måste han tänka ut ett sätt att återta positionen som skolans värsting.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Jobbiga Föräldrar
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max är irriterade över familjens regler och använder en av Max apparater för att få Hank och Barb att bete sig som tonåringar. Men att då få ta över ansvaret som föräldrar får tonåringarna att ångra sig.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Strimligt
programme.desc: Phoebe blir förkrossad när hon tror att familjens nya dokumentförstörare av misstag förstört hennes konsertbiljetter till MKTO. I själva verket har Max tagit dem för att bjuda sin nya kärlek på konserten. Gästartister: Sidney Park och MKTO.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Phoebe Rockar
programme.desc: Phoebe försöker bli en tuff tjej för att imponera på Max nya bästa vän, en tuff rocker och frontfigur i Max nya band. Gästartist: Lizzie Green.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: En Dag i Gallerian
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max förvandlar en enkel tur till gallerian för att hämta Hanks födelsedagspresent till slagsmål, kaos och en kontrovers med vakten som hotar att förstöra deras pappas födelsedag.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Det Stora Fiaskot
programme.desc: Max vill försöka vinna en tävling för mest misslyckade video med en 'misslyckad' video med Phoebe när hon övar balett. När Phoebe får veta hans plan vägrar hon att samarbeta och Max tar till desperata åtgärder för att få de bilder han vill ha.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Vänner För Alltid
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max oroar sig för att de ska behöva umgås för jämnan när deras vänner börjar hänga med varandra. Syskonen tar till fula knep för att se till att det blir pinsamt för alla när de går på bio.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: De Hemsökta Thundermans Del 1
programme.desc: När en superskurk rymmer från Spökvärlden på Halloween, beger sig Thundermans till New Orleans för att tillsammans med Hathaways och Prestons besegra demonen.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Mammas Superfan
programme.desc: Max och Phebe säljer av misstag några av Barbs gamla superhjältesaker till en superfan till Electress på familjens loppis, och måste skaffa tillbaka dem innan hon upptäcker det.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Råtta på Rymmen
programme.desc: Max förvandlar Billy till världens snabbaste råtta för att vinna råttävlingarna han har med killarna i bandet. Billy som fått smak på att springa med superfart bestämmer sig för att han inte vill bli människa igen.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Ett vintrigt Thunderland
programme.desc: Max är som den värsta Scrooge strax innan jul, tills de förflutna, nuvarande och kommande jularnas andar dyker upp för att få honom i julstämning.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Evilmans
programme.desc: Det artar sig till en Romeo & Julia i supertappning när en pensionerad superskurk som råkar vara Thunder Mans gamla ärkefiende flyttar till Hiddenville, och hans son och Phoebe börjar träffa varandra i smyg.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Den Blåa Detektiven
programme.desc: När Max hud blir blå under en dejt blir alla misstänkta när han agerar superdetektiv för att finna den skyldiga.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: En Hjälte Föds Del 1
programme.desc: Phoebe och Cherrys vänskap sätts på prov när Thundermans får oväntade nyheter och måste förbereda sig för överraskningen. Max följer med Dr. Colosso som ska ta emot priset för årtiondets skurk. Gäststjärnor: Dana Snyder, Paul F. Tompkins.

programme.title: Just for Laughs GAGS
programme.desc: Dolda kameran med riktiga människor, livs levande actionkomedi! Njut av galenskapen från världens längst pågående och mest älskade skämtshow, där intet ont anande människor hamnar i lustiga situationer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Invisible Intruder
programme.desc: In 1996, police received a call from Darlie Routier telling them of her two sons' murders. The police found the killer by analyzing blood spatter, doing behavioral profiling and analyzing Darlie's 911 call.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ultimate Betrayal
programme.desc: On a windy Kansas night in 1995, a mysterious fire swept through the home of a prominent doctor. In the debris, investigators found evidence which told them how the fire started.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cement the Case
programme.desc: In 1990, Shirley Andronowich's body was found mutilated. Eyewitnesses told police she had a fight with her husband the night before, but forensic evidence proved that he had nothing to do with her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Innocence Lost
programme.desc: Sometime during a neighborhood Christmas party, five-year-old Melissa Brannen disappeared. Investigators turned to forensic science to help them see what the witnesses missed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Til Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: The doctors at the hospital couldn't determine the cause of Bobby Curley's hallucinations and intense pain. They treated it as a neurological disorder but his condition deteriorated. He was being poisoned.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ties That Bind
programme.desc: Who was the sexual offender who murdered two adolescent boys in Nebraska? The key to stopping him would be the unique composition of the "junk rope" he used to tie his victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Body of Evidence
programme.desc: Mark Fair left for work and his fiancée, Karla Brown, stayed home. Later, he found her dead. During the autopsy, bite marks on her body were re-examined and forensic odontology identified the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Accident or Murder
programme.desc: Janice Johnson was found dead at the foot of her basement stairs. Police in Nova Scotia had to unravel the circumstances surrounding Janice's death and answer the question: Was it an accident or murder?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Core Evidence
programme.desc: In 1996, more than a dozen children in Seattle, Washington, were fighting for their lives. Each one of them had contracted a serious unknown illness. After one died, investigators knew the clock was ticking.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Haunting Vision
programme.desc: Fire engulfs the home where Lori Keidel and her siblings were left alone while their father went to the laundromat. Years after her mother's disappearance, Lori tells police she witnessed her mother's death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: With Every Breath
programme.desc: Young Navajos in the Southwest were dying at an alarming rate. The tribe's medicine men provided investigators with a critical clue that would lead halfway around the world to a most unlikely killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Slippery Motives
programme.desc: Edward Post drew a bath for his wife before going for a run. He returned to find her not breathing. She died before emergency response arrived. Police considered her death accidental until a motive surfaced.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Badge of Deceit
programme.desc: Women in a Louisiana city live in fear of a rapist who leaves no clues to his identity. But technology and behavioral science combine to give police a new forensic tool. Police narrow their search to one man: local policeman Randy Comeaux.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dew Process
programme.desc: When the wife of a well-known dentist is found dead, police struggle to identify a suspect. Some fibers and a study of the weather patterns on the night of the murder break the case open and reveal the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Woman Scorned
programme.desc: When Joann Katrinak is found dead in a corn field with her infant son, the obvious suspect is the husband and father of the victims. But insects found on the bodies reveal a vital clue which uncovers a twisted story of passion gone wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Voice from Beyond
programme.desc: When a decomposed body is found stuffed in a barrel, it's easy to presume murder. But the body had been placed in the barrel 30 years earlier. One of the few clues was an address book found along with the body.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Burning Ambition
programme.desc: When a policeman's house goes up in flames, experts suspect arson. The officer whose home was torched arrests low-level drug dealer James Wren, who confesses. But when the suspect vanishes, investigators question the authenticity of the confession.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trail of Truth
programme.desc: Nancy Newman and her two daughters are found brutally murdered. The crime scene has no shortage of evidence, but investigators cannot find a conclusive link to their prime suspect. To solve the puzzle, an FBI analyst designs a unique experiment.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Material Evidence
programme.desc: When police find the body of 11-year-old Krista Harrison, there are few clues to the killer's identity. But authorities are intrigued by unusual orange fibers embedded in clothing found near the victim.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Kill'igraphy
programme.desc: This examination of the role autopsies play in murder investigations focuses on the suspicious death of Virginia Ridley. Police charge her mentally unstable husband with murder, but a medical examiner discovers that she died of natural causes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nursery Crimes
programme.desc: An investigation of a pediatrician, prompted by the mysterious death of one of her patients, leads to a Texas hospital where the pediatric mortality rate is higher than at any hospital in the country.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Lasting Impression
programme.desc: When the decomposed body of a teenage girl is discovered, police have no clues to her identity. To solve the case, investigators turn to bug larvae found on the body and a tiny wad of chewing gum found near the victim's body.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Foundation of Lies
programme.desc: Police suspect Dr. John "Jack" Boyle in the disappearance of his wife, Noreen, when he signs mortgage papers for a new house with a woman pretending to be his spouse. The police later find Noreen's body in the basement of Dr. Boyle's new house.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Vows
programme.desc: Survivors of Nazi atrocities recognized Archbishop Trifa, former head of the Romanian Orthodox Church in America, as having directed a bloody attack against Jews during World War II. He was deported in 1984 and died three years later.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Broken Promises
programme.desc: When a popular gym teacher is found dead of what appears to be an accidental gunshot wound, his family is suspicious. A tape recorded by the victim just before his death tells the true story of his strange marriage and his wife's insatiable greed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Time Will Tell
programme.desc: In this international case of extortion, murder and stolen identities, scam-artist Albert J. Walker assumes the identity of co-worker Ronald Platt. Platt later turns up dead in an ocean with an anchor tied around his torso.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Second Shot at Love
programme.desc: When heart surgeon Darryl Sutorius is found dead in the basement of his upscale Cincinnati home, police assume he committed suicide. Further investigation reveals that his new wife Della has a history of violence and an insatiable desire for money.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Journey to Justice
programme.desc: 6-year-old Nicole Rae Walker was killed in a hit-and-run in her Ft. Lauderdale neighborhood. The prosecutor combines the talents of an accident reconstruction expert with a video specialist to create a graphic demonstration of the moment of impact.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Video Diary
programme.desc: When convenience store employee Wanda Mason is found dead, investigators find the entire murder has been caught on the store's security camera. But the image of the killer is so degraded it seems impossible to positively identify him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Knowledge
programme.desc: Police investigate a missing college girl and discover her double life: attending school by day and working as a call-girl by night. Her body is found and investigators find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Missing in Time
programme.desc: A woman is reported missing after a fight with her husband. Police suspect a man who reported a fire in his car. Two tiny drops of blood are found in the interior. Finally, a tiny clue inside the suspect's watchband helps solve the case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Missing Pearl
programme.desc: In 1991, Maine resident Pearl Smith goes missing after an argument with her husband, Bill Bruns. When investigators find a blood trail that leads to the couple's basement, police are sure they'll find the victim's body.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Man's Best Friend?
programme.desc: In 1989, 4-year-old April Loveless was found dead in the backyard of her Texas home. Her parents told police that she was attacked and killed by wild dogs. Investigators did not agree.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hand Delivered
programme.desc: In 1995, San Diego police are baffled by a pair of hands found in a dumpster. Through further investigation, they determine that the hands are those of missing person Don Hardin.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fire Dot Com
programme.desc: In 1996, a federal agency ruled that Terri Strickland had intentionally set the fire that killed her 17-month-old son, Josh Hinson. Using the then-emerging resources of the internet, Strickland undertook her own investigation.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Mistaken For Dead
programme.desc: In 1988, when a patient dies unexpectedly in the office of California neurologist Richard Boggs, police begin what they think will be a routine investigation. Soon they uncover a bizarre story of corpse stealing, fake identity and sexual perversion.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Frozen Evidence
programme.desc: One investigator's quick thinking helps him capture a shoe impression made in snow before the evidence melts away. The shoe leads investigators to Peter Benedict and Frank Lanoue, who are convicted of aggravated assault and robbery.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Soft Touch
programme.desc: In 1992, 22-year-old Dawn Bruce is brutally murdered in her Virginia apartment. Investigators notice a blood smear on a pillow case that appears to have been made by one of the killer's fingers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Disappearance
programme.desc: In 1981, 6-year-old Cassie Hansen disappeared from her Minnesota church during an evening service. After receiving a tip that an older man was seen carrying a small person, police found Cassie's body in a dumpster.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.
programme.sub-title: The True Story of Mississippi Burning

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Identity
programme.desc: When a theft is committed, something valuable is stolen. But when a criminal needs a new identity, theft becomes a matter of life and death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Critical Evidence
programme.desc: To the astute detective and forensic specialist, the biggest clues often hide in plain sight, and what seems trivial to some is in reality Critical Evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Secrets
programme.desc: Killers often attempt to deflect attention away from their crimes by hiding the remains of their victims. Bodies may lay hidden for years before they are discovered.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Killers
programme.desc: Weeks pass as forensic investigators search for even the smallest clues, only to find what they feared in their own backyard. In Canada, two people die suddenly of unknown causes, and their deaths may not be as coincidental as they first appear.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Flames Of Justice
programme.desc: Arson fires are set for their own sake, or to cover a different crime, such as murder. Think fire consumes all vital clues? Think again. Arson investigators can glean important clues from scorched rubble and ignite the unquenchable flames of justice.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Military Justice
programme.desc: The Naval Criminal Investigative Service uses forensic science to solve three perplexing murders and fulfill their motto: "To the living we owe respect; to the dead, we owe the truth."

programme.title: The New Detectives: Medical Examiners's Casebook
programme.desc: Some killers choose to hide their victims. And investigators must then rely on forensic examiners to uncover proof of murder. These are just two extraordinary crimes that have made their way into the medical examiner's casebook.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Raw Greed
programme.desc: A friendly Midwest lodge becomes the scene of a gruesome double murder. Two men are dead and a safe filled with cash is missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Witness
programme.desc: Three hairs, microscopic fibers, a common trash bag ripped from a roll. Seemingly small and insignificant clues become a victim's silent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blood Money
programme.desc: Some people murder for love. But these killers did it for the money. When greed is the motive, investigators must make every clue pay off.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner's Casebook
programme.desc: A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Absent Witness
programme.desc: When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Men Do Talk
programme.desc: Profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts and the procedures they use to solve murders and other mysteries in minutes or centuries after they happen.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Web of Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Entomology: Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fateful Twist
programme.desc: A southeastern Virginia community is stunned by a crime no one can believe. A pregnant woman murdered, her baby lost. Across the state, another town feels a similar shock, a brutal, random slaying in a most unexpected setting.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Marked For Death
programme.desc: Sometimes killers are careful to leave no fingerprints behind. But methods of the murder itself can leave a lasting impression on police, especially when the tools (or weapons) of a killer's trade leave an innocent victim marked for death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trails of Evidence
programme.desc: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Deadly Smile
programme.desc: Investigators rely on forensic odontology to identify a body from a single tooth and to catch two brutal killers from their bite marks.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Mill Street Barracks
programme.desc: Built in 1861 Mill Street Barracks is steeped in rich history. It has accommodated many branches of the armed forces throughout its life. Like many other barracks it has also been used as a morgue making it a prime location for the supernatural.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker
programme.desc: The Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker is a former government-owned nuclear bunker located at Hack Green, Cheshire, England. It Started as a decoy site for enemy bombers but later developed into a legitimate base. Now it is ripe with hauntings.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Drakelow Tunnels
programme.desc: The Drakelow Tunnels are a former underground military complexused mainly for storage. However, during the construction and running of this facility, 6 people are thought to have died.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Razor Ruddock's Home
programme.desc: We visit the home of Soccer legend Neil "Razor" Ruddock which seems to be haunted. Is it his home specifically? Or are these ghosts attached to him?

programme.title: Past Hunters: Blackpool Pleasure Beach
programme.desc: Blackpool Pleasure Beach is one of the most visited attractions in the United Kingdom. People visit it not only for the fun, but to also hopefully catch a glimpse of the many ghosts that haunt there.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Whitby Hall
programme.desc: Built in the early 1800s, Whitby Hall used to be an administrative center and now stands as a public park and arts center. It has never before been investigated, but staff have reported many noises and presences among them.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Carnfield Hall
programme.desc: Carnfield Hall is a country house dating from the 15th and 16th Centuries. This private residence turn event hall is using its paranormal activity to draw in business. Are these spirits the old residents?

programme.title: Past Hunters: Tutbury Castle
programme.desc: The team head to Tutbury Castle in Derbyshire to investigate the paranormal reports at the location. Past Hunters appear to have caught the Tutbury Ghost on camera.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Ordsall Hall
programme.desc: Ordsall Hall is over 820 years old. It has been put to many uses including a family home, working men's club and church hall. With over 15 hauntings and many sightings, Ordsall Hall will certainly keep the team busy.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Hull to investigate ghostly goings on inside of a former chocolate factory. The investigation turns out to be no picnic, as the ghosts haunting make direct contact with the team.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Parade
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Hoylake and investigate a building known as The Parade. Dating back to 1909, this once former school, still seems to have ghostly pupils and teachers taking class.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Knutsford Crown Court – Part 1
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Knutsford and investigate a former Crown Court. Multiple people have been sentenced to death and life in prison, but will the team encounter any of its former inmates tonight?

programme.title: Past Hunters: Knutsford Crown Court – Part 2
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters continue their investigation of Knutsford Crown Court. As they delve deeper into the building, will the ghosts and spirits make contact through Derek?

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Mill – Part 1
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Stockport and investigate an abandoned Mill, Weir Mill, said to the most haunted Mill in the UK. Demonic figures haunt anyone that enters. Will the team survive the night with the spirits?

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Mill – Part 2
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters continue their investigation of Weir Mill and the search for paranormal activity takes a darker turn. Will they finally uncover the truth behind the buildings dark hauntings?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Sean and Bex begin their chilling investigation at the historic Clifton Hall Masonic Temple. Hidden behind closed doors for over a century, this sacred space holds more than just ritual secrets. They explore the eerie corridors and lodge rooms.
programme.sub-title: Secrets of the Masonic Temple – Part 1

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: The investigation continues as Bex and Sean split up to face the darkness alone inside Clifton Hall. From intelligent knocking and voices to the chilling sound of a child and unseen footsteps on the carpet.
programme.sub-title: Secrets of the Masonic Temple – Part 2

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: In a church reborn as a gym, something old still lingers in the shadows. Sean and Bex investigate Dream Body Gym inside the former Manor Church — where whispers echo through stairwells, music box melodies drift through empty rooms.
programme.sub-title: Haunted Strength – The Church Gym Investigation

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Deep in the woods on the outskirts of Liverpool lie the crumbling remains of a forgotten gatehouse — and the land surrounding it is said to be cursed. As Sean and Bex begin their nighttime investigation, unsettling activity begins to unfold.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Sean and Bex head to one of Leeds’ oldest public libraries, where the silence hides more than just books. Reports of shadow figures, unexplained voices, and a terrifying presence in the basement have kept rumours alive for decades.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: We Can't Live Like This
programme.desc: Thornton says he can't trust his cheating girlfriend Crystal and wants her to take a lie detector test! Plus, Stephanie wants to prove to her husband Mathew that she's not having sex with her own family member! She wants the accusations put to rest.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I'm Raising Him, But Is He Mine?
programme.desc: Deshawn claims that his ex Lynette abandoned their 5-year-old son. But she claims that he is keeping her from their child. However, Deshawn recently found out that he isn't listed on his son's birth certificate, so he wants a DNA test!
