programme.title: Secret War: The French Triple Agent
programme.desc: Operation Cockade, led by MI6's double agent Henri Dericourt in 1943, aimed to deceive Germans with sabotage. Despite efforts, Germans withdrew divisions unconvinced. Dericourt faced a post-war treason trial and died in a mysterious 1962 plane crash.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Misfits Gather
programme.desc: Hitler finds his political destiny in post-war Munich. He quickly dominates a fringe party & builds it into the Nazi Party. He recruits infamous men to the cause including Herman Goering & Heinrich Himmler & they plot a coup known as the Beerhall Putsch.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Belgian Collaborator
programme.desc: Leon Degrelle, a charismatic Belgian leader, joined the Nazis and led Die Wallonien on the Eastern Front. Despite no military background, he earned the Knight's Cross for valor. He recruited 4000 more for the SS, defending Berlin until April 1945.

programme.title: Secret War: The Mafia Connection
programme.desc: Lucky Luciano, a mafia boss of the 1930s, was in jail in 1942 on charges of running prostitution rings. US intelligence services did a deal with him and he got the Italians to share intelligence on German U boat movements.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Special Forces operate deep behind enemy lines with top-of-the-line weapons.Host Wil Willis tests the Sig Sauer P226, the preferred choice like the Mark 25 by Navy SEALs, against competitors like the H&K Compact Tactical.

programme.title: Secret War: Hardy Amies and Operation Ratweek
programme.desc: Operation Ratweek’s existence has always been denied. However WMR has now discovered evidence that it existed and was carried out.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Host Wil Willis tests the Garand against the Arisaka Type 99, showcasing its impact in WWII and sniper rifles' deadly precision, from Carlos Hathcock to Craig Harrison. Witness the historic rifles that shaped warfare!

programme.title: Secret War: The Banker, the Norwegians & the Bomb
programme.desc: Sir Charles attended Eton, and then joined the Coldstream Guards. He won the Military Cross on the Western Front and, having survived the war, returned to banking.
programme.sub-title: The Banker, the Norwegians & the Bomb

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Croatian Collaborator
programme.desc: Croatia grapples with its fascist past through figures like Dinko Sakic, once hailed as a hero but later convicted of war crimes. Leading the notorious Jasenovac camp, Sakic oversaw brutal atrocities against inmates.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Final Solution
programme.desc: This is the story of how Hitler orchestrated the genocide of 6 million Jews. Hitler portrayed Jews as a societal threat, using Goebbels' propaganda. Deportations were masked as resettlements while Auschwitz-Birkenau became a death factory.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Could the mighty M2 be the greatest machine gun in history? Nicknamed “Ma Deuce”, this American machine gun has dominated battlefields for over 80 years. Host Wil Willis tests it and recreates Audie Murphy’s famous Medal of Honor moment.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Dutch Collaborator
programme.desc: Anton Adriaan Mussert, initially resisted Hitler’s anti-Semitism despite modeling his NSB party, even welcoming Jewish members. His failed attempt to kidnap Queen Wilhelmina led him into hiding, after which he collaborated in hopes of gaining power.

programme.title: Secret War: The SAS Italian Job
programme.desc: In 1945, during the Italian Spring offensive, SOE agent Michael Lees and SAS officer Roy Farran led a raid on German HQs at Villa Rossi and Villa Calvi. Despite orders to cancel, Farran attacked with SAS men and partisans, killing many Germans.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Artillery, "The King of Battle," has shaped history from ancient cannons to today's M777 Howitzer. Host Wil Willis visits Fort Sill, Oklahoma, to witness modern artillery like the M777 and M109 Paladin in action.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The IRA Conspiracy
programme.desc: During WWII, the IRA's "S Plan" aimed to bomb Britain, drawing German support to weaken the British. "Operation Green" and "Plan Kathleen" envisioned IRA aiding a German invasion of Northern Ireland, but both failed due to bungling and infighting.

programme.title: Mata Hari - The Beautiful Spy
programme.desc: Mata Hari. Dance, Seduction and Espionage. The enduring myth.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Hitler's Killer Police
programme.desc: In Ukraine and Lithuania, Nazi invaders were welcomed as liberators. In Lithuania, Antanas Gecas led a militia that executed hundreds of Jews. Ukrainian nationalists participated in pogroms slaughtering 34,000 Jews in two days.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Robin slösar bort alla sina pengar på dyra hobbies. Han har precis gjort slut med Madeleine från förra avsnittet, och med hennes skyhöga skulder och överdrivna utgifter är hans nya liv svårt.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Bibbi är sjuksköterska och ska snart gå i pension, men med sina skulder kommer hon inte att kunna gå i pension vid 67 års ålder. Hennes hus är fullt av kläder, smycken och tomma champagneflaskor. Kommer hon att kunna ändra sin livsstil?

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Roy Erik köper och säljer klockor varannan vecka och experterna har aldrig sett ett sådant slöseri. Han köper på impuls och säljer med förlust. Med sin höga skuld kommer han aldrig att kunna köpa ett eget hus.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Helene har en bra inkomst, men i stället för att lägga undan pengar shoppar hon. Hon lägger 13.000 norska kronor i månaden bara på nätshopping och drömmen om att köpa ett eget hus känns avlägsen.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Arild blandar ihop sin privatekonomi med sitt företag och har därför tappat kontrollen. Han har skulder på långt över en miljon kronor. Arild är en skicklig tatuerare, men hur kan han rädda sin ekonomi?

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Hilde slösar bort sin lön som lastbilschaufför på sitt bilintresse. Hon struntar i räkningarna, kylskåpet är tomt, elen är på väg att stängas av och skulderna växer.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Ellinor har sålt sitt hus och är på väg att starta om sitt liv. Trots en bra inkomst har hon det kämpigt. Experterna följer med henne under flyttprocessen och blir chockade över hur mycket pengar som läggs på onödiga inköp.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2501
programme.desc: Ørjan har köpt och sålt över 100 bilar under 13 års tid och hans tomt är full av olika fordon. Han har en bra lön, men spenderar desto mer, och när kontot ekar tomt handlas det på kredit.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2502
programme.desc: Else har skatteskulder och riskerar att bli av med sitt hus. De höga elpriserna och Elses överdrivna konsumtion av kaffe, mat och mobilspel tar över hennes budget och får framtiden att se mörk ut.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2503
programme.desc: Odins liv vändes på sin kant när han sjuk i cancer, och nu hindrar skulderna från tiden innan och under sjukdomen honom från att bygga det liv han vill ha.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Sverre och experterna blir chockade då ett brev dyker upp om att Sverres hus måste säljas. Sverre har valt festandet före att bygga klart sitt hus, och har använt fakturor för att tända brasor.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2505
programme.desc: Daniel dricker 3 liter läsk om dagen och gamla lån har hindrat honom och Mona från att bilda familj. Mona tror att Daniel spenderat små summor på vadslagning men det visar sig handla om mer pengar.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2506
programme.desc: Ulrik har tagit stora lån för att etablera sig med familjen men har tappat kontrollen och får en otrevlig överraskning när experterna anländer.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Madeleine älskar inredning och hennes garderob är full av nyinköpta kläder. När Madeleine vill ha något nytt så köper hon det. Hon lever över sina tillgångar och de dyra lånen hopar sig.

programme.title: The Nanny: The Nanny

programme.desc: Fran persuades the family to help her dupe a nosy cousin.

programme.title: The Nanny: Sunday In The Park With Fran
programme.desc: Grace and the son of a prominent theater critic Frank Bradley get in a fight during a trip to the park, and, to break it up, Fran bops the boy with a baguette -- which could mean curtains for Maxwell's newest Broadway play.

programme.desc: Fran is cast in a Broadway production of "Romeo and Juliet."

programme.desc: Fran regrets encouraging Maxwell to hire a young TV star for his next play.

programme.desc: Fran confides in an attractive male that she thinks is gay.

programme.sub-title: A Kiss Is Just A Kiss

programme.desc: A fellow nanny's retirement causes Fran to worry about her own future.

programme.title: The Nanny: The Two Mrs. Sheffields
programme.desc: A visit by Maxwell's mother results in an unexpected marriage proposal.

programme.title: The Nanny: Fashion Show
programme.desc: Maxwell hires Fran to design the costumes for a charity benefit.

programme.title: The Nanny: Where's Fran?
programme.desc: Maxwell's insults cause Fran to quit.

programme.sub-title: Love Is A Many Blundered Thing

programme.title: The Nanny: Your Feets Too Big
programme.desc: An upcoming modeling reunion has Fran worried about aging.

programme.title: The Nanny: Where's The Pearls?
programme.desc: Fran loses both her memory and Elizabeth Taylor's priceless pearl necklace in an accident.

programme.title: The Nanny: Green Card
programme.desc: Maxwell is upset when Fran falls for Brighton's handsome French tutor.

programme.title: The Nanny: Ship Of Fran's
programme.desc: Maxwell arranges for everyone to join Fran on a Caribbean cruise.

programme.title: The Nanny: A Pup In Paris
programme.desc: A mix up ends with Fran joining Maxwell on a romantic trip to Paris.

programme.title: The Nanny: The Tart With Heart
programme.desc: Upon returning from Paris, Maxwell takes back his loving words to Fran.

programme.title: The Nanny: Me And Mrs. Joan
programme.desc: Fran arranges a reunion between Maxwell and his estranged father, James.

programme.title: The Nanny: Tattoo
programme.desc: Maxwell is aroused after learning that Fran has a secret tattoo.

programme.title: The Nanny: Danny's Dead And Who's Got The Will?
programme.desc: Fran goes to her former fiance Danny's funeral, and fearing she may end up alone, she pushes Maxwell for a commitment.
programme.sub-title: Danny's Dead And Who's Got The Will?

programme.title: The Nanny: The Bank Robbery
programme.desc: Fran and Sylvia are taken hostage in a Valentine's Day bank robbery.

programme.title: The Nanny: From Flushing With Love
programme.desc: Fran uses a trip to Niagara Falls to inspire Maxwell to propose.

programme.title: The Nanny: One False Mole And You're Dead
programme.desc: Fran accidentally discovers the secret behind a movie star's famous beauty mark.

programme.title: The Nanny: Not Without My Nanny

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Charles Matthews berättar en hemsk hemlighet för Blake. Zorelli hittar en insekt gömd i sin lägenhet. Alexis berättar för Monica att Jason Colby inte är hennes far.

programme.title: Dynasty

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: När Krystle Grant Jennings förbereder sig för att gifta sig med den rika oljemagnaten Blake Carrington återvänder Matthew Blaisdel, en tidigare älskare, till staden och får henne att tänka om.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Brådskande affärer avbryter Blake och Krystles smekmånad. Steven tar ett jobb hos Matthew Blaisdel. Cecil föreslår att Fallon ska gifta sig med hans brorson.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake bjuder Matthew på middag för att locka honom att återvända till Denver-Carrington. Krystle hamnar i konflikt med chefsbutlern Joseph. Matthew berättar för Krystle att han fortfarande är kär i henne.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Stevens före detta älskare Ted anländer från New York. Fallon gifter sig motvilligt med Jeff Colby. Blake anlitar Michael, chauffören, för att göra undercover-arbete för Denver-Carrington.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Steven hånas på jobbet för att han är homosexuell. Blake får reda på villkoren för Fallons äktenskap med Jeff. Steven känner sig attraherad av Claudia.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Walter tar med Steven till en bordell. Steven får skulden för att ha saboterat Matthews rigg. Krystle pantsätter sina diamanter för att hjälpa Matthew ekonomiskt.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Efter att ha fått sparken för att ha saboterat Matthews utrustning får en oskyldig Steven reda på att han blev lurad. Lindsay blir förkrossad när hon får veta om sin födelse.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Matthew och Walters hittar olja. Fallon ber att få låna halsbandet som Krystle pantsatt för att hjälpa Matthew. I sin stuga i bergen älskar Steven och Claudia.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Steven meddelar att han flyttar från herrgården. Chauffören Michael berättar för Blake om Stevens affär med Claudia. Fallon återupptar relationen med Michael.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake får reda på att Krystle pantsatt sitt smaragdhalsband för att hjälpa Matthew. Fallon berättar för Jeff att hon gifte sig med honom enbart för sin fars skull. Stevens tidigare älskare Ted anländer till Denver.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Steven berättar för Claudia att han tillbringade natten med Ted. Krystle lämnar Blake. Blake ser Ted omfamna sin son och slår honom. Steven anklagar sin far för mord.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake måste ställas inför rätta för mordet på Stevens älskare. Krystle återvänder hem för att vara med Blake. Fallon vittnar för sin far men Steven tillbakavisar hennes uttalanden i rätten.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: I vittnesbåset hävdar Blake sin oskuld. Matthew får reda på Claudias affär med Steven. Claudia och dottern Lindsay är inblandade i en bilolycka.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blakes första hustru Alexis vittnar om att Blake är kapabel till våld. Matthew sticker iväg med Lindsay. Alexis berättar för Steven om sin kärlek till honom. Juryn meddelar att de har nått en dom.

programme.desc: Richie & Seth hatch a plan to complete Santanico's revenge & walk away with the score of a lifetime. Freddie & Kate find themselves facing an unexpected foe after Malvado's attack.
programme.sub-title: Bring Me the Head of Santanico Pandemonium

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: As the pieces of the big job fall into place, the uneasy trust between brothers and partners crumbles in the light of betrayals and new loyalties.
programme.sub-title: The Last Temptation of Richard Gecko

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.desc: Explorers visit a uniquely surreal abandoned house whose entire front façade has collapsed, exposing the interior like a doll's house. The adventure takes an unexpected turn when local farmers arrive and start firing a shotgun in the garden.

programme.title: Steve Ronin
programme.desc: Steve explores an abandoned 19th-century hall hidden in the Swiss Alps, uncovering eerie tunnels, untouched relics, and secrets buried for over 50 years.
programme.sub-title: The Abandoned Illuminati Ritual Gathering Hall

programme.title: Kill, Baby Kill!
programme.desc: En bergsby hemsöks av en vålnad i form av en liten mordisk flicka, vilket får en rättsläkare och en medicinstuderande att försöka avslöja hennes hemligheter medan en häxa använder sina konster för att skydda byborna.

programme.title: Summer of Fear
programme.desc: En tonårings liv rasar när hennes mystiska kusin flyttar in efter en tragedi. Märkliga händelser eskalerar och hon anar mörka krafter. När ingen tror henne måste hon avslöja sanningen innan ondskan tar över.

programme.title: Clive Barker's Lord Of Illusions
programme.desc: Scott Bakula ("Sibling Rivalry") portrays Harry D’Amour, a private detective visiting Los Angeles on a routine investigation. Harry gets more than he bargains for when he encounters Philip Swan (Kevin J. O’Connor, "The Mummy").

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: The Raven
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: The Ghoul
programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: A mad scientist trying to cure polio must obtain human spinal fluid, and resorts to nefarious means by wearing an ape suit to procure victims for his experiment without being detected.

programme.title: Gabulosis: A Summer Boy Scout Trip That Turned Into a Decades Long Mystery: What Happened to Garrett Bardsley?
programme.desc: On August 20, 2004 Garrett Bardsley told his father he was going to walk back to camp to change his clothes after falling in the water while they were fishing. He was never seen again and no clues have ever surfaced.
programme.sub-title: A Summer Boy Scout Trip That Turned Into a Decades Long Mystery: What Happened to Garrett Bardsley?

programme.title: Gabulosis: The Tragic Case of the Boy in the Bundle
programme.desc: On July 11, 1963 a fisher in the Keene Creek in Ashland, Oregon reeled in a small bundle. At the center of this bundle was the body of a small boy. A boy who would be unidentified for until 2021.
programme.sub-title: The Tragic Case of the Boy in the Bundle

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Eleanor Williams claimed she was trafficked and beaten by a grooming gang. Her Facebook post went viral and sparked protests across the UK. But the truth behind her allegations shocked everyone. A case that changed several lives forever.
programme.sub-title: Her EVIL Lies Ruined COUNTLESS Lives: The Horrific Crimes of Eleanor Williams

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In December 2019, 30-year-old Nadine Lott was brutally beaten by her ex-partner Daniel Murtagh in her Arklow, Ireland apartment. A neighbor witnessed him attacking her "like a wild animal," growling with rage. She died days later.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Sydney Loofe went on a Tinder date and never came home. The investigation uncovered a calculated murder planned by two predators. A solved true crime case that will stay with you.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Alice Ruggles was stalked and murdered by her obsessive ex-boyfriend after the system failed to protect her. Her family now fights to make sure it doesn't happen again. A solved true crime case everyone needs to hear.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Horrific Murder of Alice Ruggles

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In October 1983, 15-year-old Tony Muncy's dismembered remains were found in garbage bags along a rural Ohio road. The case went cold for decades until DNA genealogy identified killer Daniel Anderson in 2020.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: When Mengqi Ji vanished, her husband claimed she walked out on him. But cell phone data, muddy boots, and a juniper tree in a state park told a very different story. A solved true crime case about control, lies, and justice.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Tragic Case of Mengqi Ji

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In November 1993, 19-year-old college student Wanda Musk was abducted at knifepoint from her gas station job in Flint, Michigan, and beaten to death. DNA from a prisoner law finally solved the case in 2013.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In January 2018, 19-year-old gay college student Blaze Bernstein was lured to a California park by former classmate Samuel Woodward, who stabbed him 28 times. Woodward was convicted of hate crime murder in 2024.

programme.title: Gabulosis: The John Doe in the Grand Canyon Garage: The Haunting Mystery of The Kolb Skeleton
programme.desc: In 1977, a human skeleton dating back to 1933 was found hidden in the rafters of famed photographer Emery Kolb's garage at the Grand Canyon. Its identity remains unknown to this day.
programme.sub-title: The John Doe in the Grand Canyon Garage: The Haunting Mystery of The Kolb Skeleton

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A doctor is gunned down on the Ohio Turnpike in what looks like a random robbery. His grieving wife told a convincing story until investigators proved she ordered the hit. A solved true crime case that is brutal, calculated, and deeply personal.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Case of Dr. Gulam Moonda // MURDER FOR HIRE PLOT

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A Coast Guard mother's baby is found dead in her crib in Alaska. What looked like SIDS turned into a criminal case built on a coerced confession, so the conviction fell apart in court. A true crime case full of unanswered questions.
programme.sub-title: US Coast Guard Confessed to Smothering her Baby, but the Case Fell Apart

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: She sent voice notes to friends saying she feared the worst. Weeks later, a gunman broke into her home looking for her boyfriend and opened fire. A solved true crime case that is devastating, gang-fuelled, and a stark warning about deadly loyalty.
programme.sub-title: She PREDICTED Her Own Murder: The TERRIFYING Killing of Ashley Dale that Lead to MULTIPLE Arrests

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A pastor's pregnant wife is shot during a home invasion while he's at the gym. Police cleared him fast, but the public wasn't convinced. A solved true crime case full of suspicion, conspiracy theories, and heartbreak.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED? The Tragic Murder of Amanda Blackburn // WAS IT REALLY HER HUSBAND?!

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: Illinois serial killer Bruce Lindahl accidentally severed his own femoral artery while stabbing a victim in 1981, dying on the spot. Decades later, DNA forensics posthumously linked him to over 12 murders.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1994, 6-year-old Rikki Neave was strangled by 13-year-old James Watson in Peterborough, England. His mother was wrongly accused. DNA evidence eventually solved the case in 2022, nearly 30 years later.
programme.sub-title: The Boy Who Almost Got Away

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A man meets a woman on Facebook who says she needs help. Hours later, his throat is slashed and he's thrown off a bridge into a river. Against all odds, he survived. A solved true crime case that is savage, predatory, and an incredible story of survival.
programme.sub-title: She used Facebook to Lure him in... Then she Slit his Throat & Threw him off a Bridge

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A woman stalks and kills her estranged husband's new girlfriend in broad daylight while witnesses watch. She tried to cover it up, but the evidence was overwhelming. A solved true crime case that is vicious, obsessive, and heartbreakingly avoidable.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: Jealous Wife Kills Her Husband's New GF: The Tragic Case of Michelle Boat & Tracy Mondabough

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A Belize police superintendent is found dead in the water, shot with his own gun. The only witness? A Canadian socialite with ties to one of the country's most powerful families. Her story didn't add up.
programme.sub-title: MURDER OR ACCIDENT? The Devastating Case of Henry Jemmott and Jasmine Hartin

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Parceremonin tvingar ytterligare en tjej att checka ut och frågan är, kan lojalitet leda till attraktion? Åtminstone verkar det fungera så på Paradise Hotel.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Skolveckan är i full gång och det vankas prov i ordkunskap. Kärlek blomstrar mellan ett par av eleverna och Frökens Favorit checkar in.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En av eleverna tvingas checka ut när Frökens Favorit tar hans partner, och fler elever börjar känna kärleken spira. Skolans Värsting gör entré och det är ingen duvunge som kommer.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Vem målade Mona-Lisa? Och är Kuwait ett land eller en frukt? Nya prövningar väntar eleverna när en immunitet står på spel. Dessutom rör en dagsfest upp starka känslor – precis innan parceremonin.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En lojal partner är A och O på Paradise Hotel men, en back up är minst lika viktigt. Ytterligare en kille tvingas lämna hotellet och den efterföljande festen får svartsjuka att blossa upp.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Cirkusen har anlänt till Paradiset men, faror lurar i manegen. En galen mördarclown är lös på hotellet och när som helst kan någon bli mördad och tvingas checka ut.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Festen får svartsjukan att frodas och teorierna om vem som är hotellets mördarclown går isär. Två spådamer checkar in för att hjälpa till att lösa mysteriet men, vad är egentligen den röda tråden?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Pandoras Ask kommer aldrig lägligt men kanske extra olägligt just ikväll. En allians ”behind the scenes” blir allt starkare, men kommer spådamerna att lyssna på den alliansen eller inte?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det är aldrig kul när en annan tjej vill ha ens kille och speciellt inte på Paradise Hotel. Hemliga allianser riskerar att avslöjas när parceremonin tvingar alla att visa sina rätta färger.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Är det ostvecka på hotellet? Dags för lederhosen och dirndl när gästerna hamnat i Alperna. Ett välbekant ansikte checkar in, redo att ge allt och bara tänka på sig själv.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En av killarna lägger näsan i… smink, och frågan är hur det kommer påverka spelet för hans del framöver. Ytterligare ett känt ansikte gör entré, redo att hämnas på sina motståndare.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Hotellets after ski bjuder på både bråk och kaos. Svartsjukan bubblar över för ett av paren och den stela stämningen sprider sig på hotellet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En kille ska checka ut men, planer smids bakom stängda dörrar och allt kan hända på Paradise Hotel.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Dags för en sjukt het vecka där gästerna har förvandlats till sjuksköterskor och brandmän. En ny patient checkar in för att få sitt brända hjärta omhändertaget och en gäst börjar tvivla på sin pakt.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Gårdagens fest har satt sina spår, både i form av bakfylla och tvivel. Det hettar till ordentligt när hotellets brandmän bjuder på show.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Gästerna håller inte igen under Pandoras Ask och den dåliga stämningen hänger kvar länge. Trögpakten bildas, något som inte faller i god jord hos de andra gästerna nu när parceremoni står för dörren.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Vilken pakt får patientens lojalitet? Och vem får checka ut från Paradiset? Det har blivit dags för parceremoni!

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det är dags för gästerna att ge sig ut och resa. En bekant säkerhetsvakt checkar in för att stoppa en av resenärerna i tullen.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det hettar till ordentligt mellan två av gästerna, men hemligheten läcker snabbt ut och frågan är vad konsekvenserna kommer att bli. Dessutom checkar en välkänd pilot in.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det vankas parceremoni och resan kommer att ta slut för en av gästerna. Stämningen är minst sagt hätsk efteråt och skriken ekar på hotellområdet. Pakterna i paradiset är tydligare än någonsin.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Hotellet har förvandlats till en festival. Två artister checkar in, den ena lite mer välkänd än den andra... En av gästerna får det hett om öronen när han måste stå till svars för sina handlingar.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det mytomspunna hotellet på Mexikos dramatiska västkust slår återigen upp portarna och det är ett taggat gäng som checkar in. Men, allt kan hända på Paradise Hotel och särskilt i händerna på JLC.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: JLC fortsätter styra premiärveckan med järnhand och redan andra dagen kommer tiden på hotellet vara över för några av gästerna. Starka känslor har etablerats mellan flera av deltagarna.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Känslorna fortsätter svalla på hotellet och spelet är i full gång. En tjej tvingas checka ut och planer smids inför den kommande parceremonin.

programme.desc: Dylan, Beka og Trance tager med Rommie for at finde ud af noget om et våben, der udvikles på en planet, som ikke har tillid til AI.

programme.title: Andromeda: Una Salus Victus
programme.desc: Andromeda har til opgave at eskortere medicinske skibe sikkert gennem Drago-Kazov-rummet

programme.title: Andromeda: Hjemmefester
programme.desc: En planet med overlevende fra Commonwealth, som ledes af Dylans tidligere forlovede, bliver inviteret til at slutte sig til det nye Commonwealth.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ind i labyrinten
programme.desc: En agent fra Abyss forsøger at lokke Harper til at slutte sig til Magog.

programme.title: Andromeda: Prinsen
programme.desc: Da de redder en ung prins fra et oprør, der dræber resten af hans familie, bliver Dylan og Tyr bedt om at blive hans rådgivere.

programme.title: Andromeda: Bunker Hill
programme.desc: Dylan og hans nye flåde fra Commonwealth tager kampen op mod Drago-Kazov-flåden, men finder den meget større end forventet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ouroboros
programme.desc: Magog-æggene i Harper er begyndt at klække, så holdet bygger en Tesseract-maskine.

programme.title: Andromeda: Lava og raketter
programme.desc: Dylan overtager en turistbåd i et forsøg på at undslippe lejesoldaterne.

programme.title: Andromeda: Alle mine synder skal huskes
programme.desc: En identifikation af et lig går galt, da det viser sig, at Bekas tidligere besætningsmedlem ikke er død.

programme.title: Andromeda: Enfluernes dans
programme.desc: Andromeda redder døende mennesker fra en drivkraft, men de bliver snart til zombier, der styres af et hive-mind.

programme.title: Andromeda: I himlen er der nu tre
programme.desc: Skaberens motor er i stand til at omskrive universet efter ejerens ønsker. Dylan, Beka og Trance må få fat i den, før nogen med mørke planer får fat i den.
programme.sub-title: I himlen er der nu tre

programme.title: Andromeda: Det, vi ikke kan ændre
programme.desc: Et sort hul slår Dylan ud og sender ham ind i en alternativ virkelighed med kone og barn.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den skønne ukendte
programme.desc: Besætningen redder en af de længe forsvundne grundlæggere af Commonwealth, men opdager, at hun måske er mere besværlig, end hun er værd.

programme.title: Andromeda: Udyrets mave
programme.desc: Et mytologisk rumuhyre forsøger at æde Andromeda.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ridderen, døden og djævelen
programme.desc: Dylan forsøger at befri en flåde af tilfangetagne skibe, men flåden er ikke sikker på, at den ønsker at blive befriet. Deres AI'er frygter, at nye kaptajner vil gøre dem til slaver.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ubesmittet opfattelse
programme.desc: Genitter angriber Tyrs kone og koloni.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tunnelen for enden af lyset
programme.desc: Med halvtreds parter om bord er Dylan vært for underskrivelsen af det nye rigsfællesskabs charter, men opdager snart, at der er ubudne gæster, der har til hensigt at stoppe underskrivelsen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Faren Begynder
programme.desc: Henry Hart er en almindelig dreng i ottende klasse, indtil han bliver håndlanger for superhelten Kaptajn Mand, hvilket han skal holde hemmeligt.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Mere Fare, Flere Problemer
programme.desc: Henry prøver at forene sig med sin nye rolle som Faredrengen, og han kæmper med at få både bekæmpelse af kriminalitet, skole, familie og venner til at gå op.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Hemmeligheden Slipper ud
programme.desc: Henrys liv som Faredrengen trues, da Charlotte bliver mere mistænksom over de hemmeligheder, han gemmer på.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tårer fra den Lystige Bille
programme.desc: Da Kaptajn-mand mistersin uovervindelighed, bliver han bange for at bekæmpe kriminalitet. Det er op til Faredrengen at sørge for Swellviews sikkerhed og finde ud af, hvordan Kaptajn-mand får sine kræfter tilbage.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Vikaren
programme.desc: Da en mistænkelig ny elev dukker op på skolen, er Charlotte og Henry sikker på, at han har skumle planer. Kaptajn-mand bliver undercover vikar for at finde ud af mere.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Fare-Jasper
programme.desc: Da Jasper klæder sig ud som Faredrengen til Halloween, går han for vidt og bliver forvekslet med den rigtige. Nu er det op til den rigtige Faredrengen og Kaptajn-mand at redde ham.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Månestenen
programme.desc: Henry kommer i vanskeligheder hjemme, da en sten fra det ydre rum viser sig, at være mere end først antaget.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Den Faldne Fødselsdagspige.
programme.desc: Henry bliver ikke inviteret til en fødselsdagsfest, fordi han bliver beskyldt for at have skubbet fødselaren ud fra hendes tag det foregående år. Kaptajn Mand træder til for at rense Henrys navn.

programme.title: Henry Danger: En Lidt for God Spiller
programme.desc: Den nye elev, Shawn, tager Henrys plads på basketholdet, selvom Henry mistænker ham for at være noget ældre, end han påstår. Kaptajn Mand må overkomme gamle uoverensstemmelser for at få hjælp af en ven. Gæstestjerne: Russel Westbrook.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry Menneskebæst
programme.desc: Henry har en vigtig date, men tingene går ikke helt som planlagt, da han ved et uheld kommer i kontakt med en sær maskine i Mandehulen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Usynlige Brad
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mands ven Brad, der ved et uheld for flere år siden blev usynlig, kommer på besøg. Der går ikke længe før alle er blevet trætte af ham.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Afsløreren
programme.desc: Henry og Ray forsøger at stoppe en yderst irriterende forbryder, der kalder sig for Afsløreren. Piper når grænsen, i forsøget på at komme med i en utroligt populær Kaptajn Mand fanklub.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Præmietyveri
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand får Henry med i hans yndlings gameshow, Spin og Vind, i forsøget på at nå til bunds i en række forbrydelser. Men Henry ender med selv at blive offer for den samme slags forbrydelse.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Supervulkanen
programme.desc: Da en supervulkan under Swellview ser ud til at kunne gå i udbrud, bliver Henry og Ray overbeviste om, at Verden snart går under. Piper er overbevist om at hun har glutenallergi.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Vold & Valentinsdag
programme.desc: Da pigen Henry er vild med, tager på date med en anden fyr på Valentinsdag, bygger Schwoz en androide, der kan hjælpe Henry med at gøre pigen jaloux. Ray tager på en ubehagelig date med en af Henrys lærere.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Fanget i Kælderen
programme.desc: Henry, Charlotte og Rays sjove planer bliver aflyst, da Jasper kommer til at aktivere nød-nedlukningen i Skidt og Kanel.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Elevatorkysset
programme.desc: Da Faredrengen redder Bianca ender de med at kysse. Henry har det fint med det, indtil han indser at Bianca kyssede Faredrengen - og ikke Henry. Det mener Henry er det samme som at have været ham utro.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Manden i huset
programme.desc: Da Henrys mor får sin pung stjålet, beslutter Kaptajn Mand sig for at flytte hjem til Henrys familie, for at beskytte dem. Men Kaptajn Mand tager rollen som manden i huset lidt for alvorligt.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Drømmefangerne
programme.desc: En skurks drømmestråle rammer Henry og spærrer ham inde i en drømmetilstand, som kun Charlotte kan redde ham ud fra.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Superhelt i Stuearrest
programme.desc: Da Henry bliver taget i at snige sig ud om aftenen, får han stuearrest. Charlotte overtager hans rolle som Kaptajn Mands makker og Piper gør hvad hun kan for at drive Henry til vanvid hjemme i huset.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kaptajn Klovn
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand forsøger at forbedre sit omdømme, ved at afholde en konkurrence, hvor man kan vinde en rundvisning af den hemmelige hule. Da vinderne bliver nogle af Henrys venner, bliver han bekymret for om hans identitet kan blive afsløret.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Spandefælden
programme.desc: Henry og Charlotte vil gerne fortælle Jasper, at Henry i virkeligheden er Faredrengen. De beslutter sig derfor for, at finde ud af om Jasper er klar til at få det at vide.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry og den Slemme Pige, del 1
programme.desc: En gruppe grafittimalere overdænger Swellview med grafittitegninger. Og imens de forsøger at finde gruppens leder, bliver Faredrengen fristet af en sød pige i gruppen, der tvinger ham til at vælge imellem pigen og Kaptajn Mand.
programme.sub-title: Henry og den Slemme Pige, del 1

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry og den Slemme Pige, Del 2
programme.desc: Faredrengen er gået med i grafittibanden, der spraymaler overalt i Swellview. Kaptajn Mand forsøger desperat at finde Faredrengen og Van, der er leder af gruppen.
programme.sub-title: Henry og den Slemme Pige, Del 2

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jaspers Virkelige Kæreste
programme.desc: Jaspers kæreste fra sommerlejren er kommet for at besøge ham, og hun bor hos Charlotte. Men kæresten bliver jaloux, og tror at Charlotte er forelsket i Jasper.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Rytmerne Fortsætter
programme.desc: Da Dr. Minyak vender tilbage, er Henry pludselig i fare, da den ondskabsfulde doktor har lavet hans bedste ven Charlotte om til en super stærk skabning, der skal fange Faredrengen og Kaptajn Mand.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Én Henry, tre Piger: Første del
programme.desc: Henry forsøger at fange Den Gale Bedste - en gammel bedstemor, der bliver ved med at terrorisere Kaptajn Mand i offentligheden. Det giver Henry udfordringer på både arbejds- og kærlighedsfronten.
programme.sub-title: Én Henry, tre Piger: Første del

programme.title: Henry Danger: En Henry, tre Piger: Anden Del
programme.desc: Henrys planer for Frikadelle-festen på Swellview Junior High School er komplicerede, da han bliver nødt til også at møde op som Faredrengen. Under festen sker der ting, der gør, at han må træffe en dramatisk beslutning.
programme.sub-title: En Henry, tre Piger: Anden Del

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry og Sortspætterne
programme.desc: Da Pipers basketballtræner stopper, træder Henry til som træner for Pipers hold i stedet. Han forsøger at piske holdet i form, men møder udfordringer fra idrætskomitéen og deres utraditionelle regler.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kaptajn Mand: på Ferie
programme.desc: Ray har givet Henry og Charlotte ansvar for Swellview, mens han er bortrejst i forbindelse med sin fætters bryllup. Der opstår problemer, da de skal klare tingene på egen hånd.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tidsnarreren
programme.desc: Da Faredrengen og Kaptajn-mand kæmper mod tidsnarreren, ryger Faredrengen uheldigvis ind i hans tidsmaskine og gennemlever derefter den samme dag om og om igen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Den Hemmelige Bøf
programme.desc: Henry har fået en invitation til Swellviews mest eksklusive restaurant og beslutter at invitere hans chef, Ray, med. Men tingene blive mere komplicerede end han regnede med.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Misundelige Henry
programme.desc: Efter at Jasper bliver rost som byens helt, bliver Henry jaloux over, at det altid er Faredrengen der får al anerkendelsen, mens han ikke selv får noget som helst.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Julefaren
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand må tilbringe julen i fængsel, da han er blevet arresteret for en mindre forbrydelse. Henry og Charlotte må hjælpe ham med at bevare julestemningen bag tremmer.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Uforgængelige Henry - 1. del
programme.desc: Henry beslutter sig for at blive usårlig ligesom Kaptajn Mand. Men tingene går ikke lige, som Henry har planlagt.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Uforgængelige Henry - 2. del
programme.desc: Henry beslutter sig for at blive usårlig ligesom Kaptajn Mand. Men tingene går ikke lige, som Henry har planlagt.

programme.title: Henry Danger: SMS, Løgne og Video
programme.desc: Da en video af Henry og Rays transformation til Faredrengen og Kaptajn Mand slipper ud, må Henry gå til ekstremer for at holde sin hemmelighed hemmelig.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Det Omvendte Univers
programme.desc: Henry og Charlotte transporteres under en storm til et parallelt univers, hvor Ray og Schwoz er onde og vil Piper til livs. Onde Ray og Onde Schwoz skal standses, og Henry og Charlotte skal tilbage til deres eget univers.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Fare og Torden
programme.desc: Under infiltration af et hemmeligt forbrydermøde, opdager Phoebe Thunderman, som hjælper Kaptajn Mand og Faredrengen, at hendes bror Max er deltager i mødet!

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ties That Bind
programme.desc: Who was the sexual offender who murdered two adolescent boys in Nebraska? The key to stopping him would be the unique composition of the "junk rope" he used to tie his victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Welcome Intrusion
programme.desc: A man tells police he shot an intruder who had attacked and murdered his wife. The husband paints a tragic picture and is dubbed a hero. Four years later, forensic evidence leads police to re-examine the motives of this so-called hero.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Broken Promises
programme.desc: When a popular gym teacher is found dead of what appears to be an accidental gunshot wound, his family is suspicious. A tape recorded by the victim just before his death tells the true story of his strange marriage and his wife's insatiable greed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign of the Crime
programme.desc: In little more than a month, two women who lived in the same apartment complex were brutally murdered. The similarities of the crime scenes led police to conclude they were dealing with a serial killer who harbored an intense hatred of women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wood-be Killer
programme.desc: A killer tries to incinerate everything that could link him to his crime. But in doing so, he inadvertently creates new forensic evidence. Detectives employ a technique never before used in a criminal investigation to bring it to light.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Expert Witness
programme.desc: In 1993, young mother Tammy Tatum was sexually assaulted and murdered in her Longmont, Colorado apartment. Police initially suspected her estranged husband, but did not have enough evidence to charge him and the case went cold.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fatal Fungus
programme.desc: An infant is rushed to the emergency room with serious breathing problems. Within months, there are more than 30 similar cases. Can doctors find the cause and a cure?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Muffled Cries
programme.desc: After inspecting storm damage to a home in Tampa, an insurance assessor simply disappeared. Thirty hours later, her body was found in a nearby river. But the killer had been careless.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cement the Case
programme.desc: In 1990, Shirley Andronowich's body was found mutilated. Eyewitnesses told police she had a fight with her husband the night before, but forensic evidence proved that he had nothing to do with her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: One for the Road
programme.desc: A married couple decided to escape the cold of winter with a mini-vacation in Key West. The wife went missing and police searched every square inch of the island; they found nothing but a pair of sandals which might have belonged to her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fashion Police
programme.desc: The victim had been stabbed more than thirty times and the crime scene was awash with her blood. Near her head, police discovered a distinctive button with strands of thread still attached.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair Line
programme.desc: Doctors don't know why a young scientist has fallen gravely ill. When tests finally reveal the cause, it's too late to save him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: DNA Dragnet
programme.desc: Digital enhancement of security camera footage shows that what appears to be a casual encounter is actually a forced abduction. When investigators suspect the crimes are not random, they fear a serial killer may be on the loose.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Plastic Puzzle
programme.desc: A man riding a bicycle was fatally injured in what police believed to be a hit-and-run accident. Tiny clues found at the scene created a picture of the vehicle which struck him and led police to its driver.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Telltale Tracks
programme.desc: The disappearance of Philadelphia college athlete Aimee Willard is investigated after her car is found on the roadside. When her body is found, the police find unusual marks and DNA evidence that eventually lead to her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pure Evil
programme.desc: In the search for the killer of two Texas teenagers, a behavioral profile led to suspect Jason Massey. Hard science proved the profile was correct, and Massey was executed by lethal injection on April 3, 2001.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Voice from Beyond
programme.desc: When a decomposed body is found stuffed in a barrel, it's easy to presume murder. But the body had been placed in the barrel 30 years earlier. One of the few clues was an address book found along with the body.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Vows
programme.desc: Survivors of Nazi atrocities recognized Archbishop Trifa, former head of the Romanian Orthodox Church in America, as having directed a bloody attack against Jews during World War II. He was deported in 1984 and died three years later.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Similar Circumstances
programme.desc: Robert Sims returns home after working the night shift and finds his wife unconscious on the kitchen floor. Their son is fast asleep in an upstairs bedroom, but their six-week-old daughter, Heather, is missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Northern Exposure
programme.desc: Alaskan hikers discover a body wrapped in sheets which were edged in orange stitching. Investigators find a tuft of red carpet fibers clinging to the sheet — threads of evidence which lead them straight to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trail of Truth
programme.desc: Nancy Newman and her two daughters are found brutally murdered. The crime scene has no shortage of evidence, but investigators cannot find a conclusive link to their prime suspect. To solve the puzzle, an FBI analyst designs a unique experiment.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Visibility Zero
programme.desc: In 1993, the Amtrak Railroad experienced the deadliest train crash in United States history when the Sunset Limited derailed while crossing Alabama's Big Bayou Canot bridge. 47 passengers and crew were killed; scores more were injured.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seeing Red
programme.desc: In 2005, the body of young mother Summer Baldwin was found in a suitcase in a Texas landfill.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Accident or Murder
programme.desc: Janice Johnson was found dead at the foot of her basement stairs. Police in Nova Scotia had to unravel the circumstances surrounding Janice's death and answer the question: Was it an accident or murder?

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Wrong Foot
programme.desc: Police were puzzled by an obscure print found at a crime scene where one man had been killed and two teenage girls were seriously injured. Neither of the girls could identify their attacker, but one simple clue helped track the footsteps of a killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trail of a Killer
programme.desc: In 2003, Kathy Lorick was murdered on a Concord, California jogging trail while talking to her husband on her mobile phone.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Haunting Vision
programme.desc: Fire engulfs the home where Lori Keidel and her siblings were left alone while their father went to the laundromat. Years after her mother's disappearance, Lori tells police she witnessed her mother's death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fate Date
programme.desc: In 2004, Rebecca Barney and her soon-to-be ex-husband Fred were found shot to death in their Tulsa, Oklahoma, home, which had been set on fire.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Best Foot Forward
programme.desc: In 2007, Shamaia Smith disappears from a strip club in East Hartford, CT. Police consider various patrons of the club but focus on local businessman Kenneth Otto.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wired for Disaster
programme.desc: Faced with three homicides that appear to be professional executions, investigators on both sides of the Atlantic must find a common thread between the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Dance
programme.desc: In 2000, the body of exotic dancer Rachel Siani was found beneath a New Jersey bridge. Investigators wondered if she had committed suicide. They discovered that Rachel offered to assist a drunk customer named John "Jack" Denofa to his motel room.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Dirty Deed
programme.desc: In this classic episode of Forensic Files, the longest-running true crime series in television history, Eileen and Derrick Severs disappear from their home in a small village in Great Britain and police find evidence of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Cross
programme.desc: In 1996, Virginia Beach police arrive at the Makdessi apartment to find the bloodied bodies of Elise Makdessi and Navy sailor Quincy Brown. But was Brown Elise's lover or her assailant?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Walking Terror
programme.desc: A neighbor watched as a man stabbed his wife, pushed her into the swimming pool and held her head under water. The husband, however, had no recollection of the crime. A jury would have to decide between evidence and the mysteries of the mind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dinner and a Movie
programme.desc: Time of death becomes pivotal after a pregnant woman is found murdered in her air-conditioned bedroom. A striking similarity between her death and an HBO movie gives examiners the clues they need to thaw out the alibi of a cold-blooded killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sex, Lies and DNA
programme.desc: While vacationing in California, Earl Morris learns that his wife has gone missing from their Arizona home. The search for Ruby Morris involves dozens of investigators and scientists — and even the Coast Guard.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Jean Pool
programme.desc: In 1984, the body of college student Laura Salmon was found on a Middle Tennessee farm, covered with her own denim jeans as well as the jeans of the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Chief Evidence
programme.desc: After the 1996 murder of Seattle residents Raquel Rivera and Jay Johnson, evidence from the couple's dog eventually ties one of the murderers to the scene.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the southwest one serial bank robber claimed his loot went to the poor, but this thief was no folk hero. He had a gun and was willing to shoot.

programme.title: The FBI Files: No Remorse
programme.desc: A burning body in a dark alley shed light on a cold-blooded killer. His partners in crime would tell the story, if they lived. In the underworld of the drug trade, even a childhood friend can quickly become an enemy.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dead Run
programme.desc: In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A kidnapping can shatter a family, bringing terror and heartache without warning. In 1984 with the flash of a gun, an ordinary business transaction became a violent abduction. In seconds, the son of a wealthy Miami developer was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1990s, neighborhoods in Detroit were terrorized by a gang of robbers. Impersonating police officers, they invaded over 100 homes robbing, raping and torturing their victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Small Town Terror
programme.desc: In a small Ohio community, an elderly woman and a teenaged boy disappeared. Because they vanished within hours of each other, police believed the cases were linked. But they didn't know how.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 70s and early 80s, a legitimate Puerto Rican independence movement took hold in the United States. But a splinter terrorist group known as the FALN was suspected of executing hundreds of bombings in major US cities.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Family Torn
programme.desc: The parents of 11 yr. old Brittany Martinez knew their daughter was no runaway. Something had happened to her, something terrible. When they failed to find Brittany in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When the victim of a violent crime is a member of law enforcement, the job of investigating becomes personal. At a United States border crossing, armed fugitives kidnapped a customs' inspector then vanished.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Undaunted
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Forsaken Trust
programme.desc: When victims of murder know their killers, they are often caught off guard. But even the best-laid plans leave traces of the forsaken trust.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner Investigator
programme.desc: CI: Coroner Investigator will reveal the most in-depth look to date into the science of death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Hidden Obsessions
programme.desc: In San Diego, California, a killer has left behind pieces of evidence. Detectives must sort through these small clues to prove murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blind Trust
programme.desc: A woman's body is found and investigators have little time and few clues to lead them to a killer who could strike again. Perpetrators try to conceal their crimes, yet savvy investigators can take the most obscure data and recreate a murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shattered Vows
programme.desc: A woman is found dead at the bottom of the basement stairs. As detectives look into the accident, they begin to question the sequence of events.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Impressions
programme.desc: 911 receives a desperate call in Fort Worth, Texas. A man's wife is shot. Forensic investigators search for clues in unlikely places, hoping the victim herself could provide information needed to determine how and why she died.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Misplaced Loyalty
programme.desc: In Northern California, a fire rages in the middle of the night. A woman's charred body is discovered in the smoldering aftermath.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Killing Time
programme.desc: A killer may strike in the middle of the night, and hide clues well. But the police are always there, ready and working, and they will never give up when they're on the trail of criminals who decide it's Killing Time.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Killers
programme.desc: Weeks pass as forensic investigators search for even the smallest clues, only to find what they feared in their own backyard. In Canada, two people die suddenly of unknown causes, and their deaths may not be as coincidental as they first appear.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out To Kill
programme.desc: An abandoned car outside Philadelphia brings heartbreak to a family and terror to a community. A young woman is dead, the killer gone. But the marks of his passage remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Raw Greed
programme.desc: A friendly Midwest lodge becomes the scene of a gruesome double murder. Two men are dead and a safe filled with cash is missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murderous Attraction
programme.desc: In Columbus, Ohio, a woman is found shot in the head. The death is ruled a suicide, but something is not right and detectives refuse to let the matter rest.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Trust
programme.desc: A New York homebuyer gets more than he bargained for when a house inspection turns up a mummified corpse. For decades, the crime had gone undiscovered. The victim unmissed, and the killer unpunished.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Price of Murder
programme.desc: Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Youths
programme.desc: A young girl playing in her yard in Spokane, Washington suddenly vanishes. In St. Louis, another girl leaves to visit a friend. She never arrived.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Loved To Death
programme.desc: A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover. Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written in Blood
programme.desc: In North Carolina, the home of a prominent couple becomes an unlikely scene of terrible bloodshed. Across the country, a California woman vanishes, worrying her family and the investigators trying to find her.

programme.desc: Lauren og Audrina kæmper for at redde deres venskab, men det kan allerede være for sent. Spencer har fået nok af Heidis søster Holly og tager sagen i egne hænder. Og Brody og Doug forlader fængslet med nye historier.

programme.title: The Hills: You Always Miss a Best Friend
programme.desc: Heidis søster Holly tager kontakt med Lauren, noget som tvinger både Lauren og Heidi til at revurdere hvad der er sket med dere venskab.. Audrina og Justins forhold bliver sat på prøve, da hun arbejder på en event for Epic Records.
programme.sub-title: You Always Miss a Best Friend

programme.title: The Hills: When Lauren's Away...
programme.desc: Da Lauren tager på ferie med familien, går alting galt i Los Angeles. Stephanie dater Doug bag Laurens rygg, og Audrina og Heidi bliver venner.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Act Innocent
programme.desc: Sandheden om Stephanies forhold til Laurens eks Doug kommer frem, da de alle mødes til Dougs poolparty. Heidis mor kommer overraskende på besøg til LA og ryger ud i en konfrontation med Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: If She Never Met Spencer...
programme.desc: Lauren får et brev fra Heidi, hvor hun beklager og indser, at der kun er én ting, som forhindrer dem i at blive venner igen. Audrina starter med at date en ny fyr for at gøre Justin jaloux, men hendes plan slår fejl.

programme.title: The Hills: Who To Choose?
programme.desc: Audrina møder sin gamle flamme Corey igen og jonglerer pludselig to fyre. Spencer tvinger Heidi til at smide sin søster Holly ud af lejligheden.

programme.title: The Hills: You'll Never Have This
programme.desc: Lauren og Audrina rejser til Cabo til Brody fødselsdag, men da Justin bliver jaloux på Audrinas nye forhold, udvikler festen sig til en slåskamp. Spencer ydmyger Stephanie da hun finder ud af, at hendes nye kæreste er ven med Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: I Want You To Be With Me
programme.desc: Lauren prøver at skabe fred mellem Brody og Stephanie. Audrina vil få tingene til at fungere med Corey, men Justin vil ikke give slip på hende. Stephanie tvivler på sin nye kæreste, da han bryder sit løfte om at konfrontere Brody.
programme.sub-title: I Want You To Be With Me

programme.title: The Hills: It's Her Move
programme.desc: Audrina får sit eget sted, og håber, at Justin vil flytte ind hos hende, men alle frygter, at hun flytter af den forkerte grund. Heidi inviterer Spencer til et arrangement med arbejdet og bliver taget i at have det lidt for sjovt.

programme.title: The Hills: Back To New York
programme.desc: Whitney tager til New York i forventning om at møde Alex igen, men en ny fyr ved navn Jay fanger hendes opmærksomhed. Heidi er ulykkelig efter fyringen, men da Spencer taler med Brent for at skaffe hende jobbet tilbage, forværrer han situationen.

programme.title: The Hills: One Last Chance
programme.desc: Lauren lader Heidis søster overnatte. Justin inviterer Audrina med på en romantisk weekend, og Heidis frustration med Spencer vokser, da hun må tigge for at få sit job tilbage.

programme.title: The Hills: You Did This
programme.desc: Audrina tror på et rygte, hun hører: at Lauren har kysset med Justin. I mellemtiden prøver Holly at få Heidi væk fra Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: It's About Trust
programme.desc: Audrina forsøger at redde sit venskab med Lauren efter at have anklaget hende for at have kysset med Justin. Spencer og Stephanie besøger deres bedstemore, som er træt af, at de skændes.

programme.title: The Hills: Dream Boy, Dream Job
programme.desc: Whitney bliver tilbudt en chance for a score sit drømmejob NYC og håber at se Jay der. Lauren bliver nostalgisk, da hendes forældre sælger huset i Laguna Beach, og Stephanie går til Spencer for at få hjælp med Cameron.

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. & Mrs. Pratt
programme.desc: Spencer og Heidi ignorerer deres bekymrede familier og stikker af til Mexico for at blive gift. Whitney går efter drømmejobbet i New York City, og siger farvel til Lauren og sit liv i Los Angeles.

programme.title: The Hills: I Heidi Take Thee Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren og Heidi mødes og husker, hvorfor de plejede at være venner. Spencer og Heidi er lige blevet gift, da Heidis mor kommer til byen. Justin chokerer Audrina, da han tager hende med til Palm Springs til en overraskelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Cry On Your Birthday
programme.desc: Da Heidi kommer uanmeldt til Laurens fødselsdagsfest, græder de to gamle venner over deres ødelagte venskab. Spencer kommer op at slås, da Cameron beskylder ham for at samle en bartender op.

programme.title: The Hills: Everything Happens for a Reason
programme.desc: Spencers flirtende opførsel får Heidi til at tage hjem til Colorado, hvor hun møder en gammel kæreste. Lauren skælder Stephanie ud for at have inviteret Heidi til festen. Spencer ender en lang stilhed med Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Da Heidi overrasker Spencer på en natklub med bartenderen Stacie, forlanger hun, at de går i parterapi. Lauren risikerer sit rygte, da hun skaffer Stephanie en praktikplads hos People's Revolution.

programme.title: The Hills: Crazy In Love
programme.desc: Audrina prøver at komme sig over Justin ved at gå efter Brody. Heidi slæber en modvillig Spencer med til parterapi. Da Stephanie kvajer sig hos People's Revolution, truer Lauren med at fyre hende.

programme.title: The Hills: I Always Had A Little Crush
programme.desc: Audrina prøver at glemme Justin ved at score Brody, da pigerne tager med på drengenes surf-tur til Hawaii. Heidis uskyldige ekskæreste kommer på besøg, og hun håber, at hans værdier vil smitte af på Spencer.
programme.sub-title: I Always Had A Little Crush

programme.title: The Hills: Playmates Bring the Drama
programme.desc: Audrina bliver knust, da Brodys kæreste konfronterer hende om Hawaii og Brody ikke gør noget for at stoppe det. Heidi opsnapper en sms fra Stacie til Spencer og tager på natklub for at konfrontere hende.

programme.title: The Hills: Keep Your Enemies Closer
programme.desc: Justin konfronterer Audrina om at være sammen med Brody i Hawaii. Stephanie ødelægger en fotooptagelse på jobbet, så Lauren får skældud af Kelly. Bartenderen Stacie prøver at slutte fred med Heidi.

programme.title: The Hills: Father of The Bride
programme.desc: Spencer prøver at redde sit forhold til Heidi ved at bede hendes cowboyfar om tilladelse til at gifte sig med hende. Lauren må fyre Stephanie fra People's Revolution og risikerer deres venskab.

programme.title: The Hills: Hi Lauren, It's Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren overvejer, om hun skal tage til Heidis bryllup, efter Spencer omsider siger undskyld. Brody nægter at risikere sit forhold til Jayde for at redde sit forhold til Audrina, og Stephanie konfronterer Kelly Cutrone.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Old, Something New
programme.desc: I Laurens sidste afsnit, må hun beslutte, om hun er villig til at tilgive Spencer for at kunne være der for Heidi til hendes 'prinsesse'-bryllup. Alle de medvirkende dukker op og bliver chokeret af en overraskende gæst.

programme.title: The Hills: It's On Bitch
programme.desc: Kristin starter en krig, da hun lægger an på Justin lige foran Audrina. Spencer ser på huse med Heidi og køber et hus uden hendes godkendelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Mess With Me, I Mess With You
programme.desc: Da Audrina brænder Kristin af, beslutter hun sig for ikke at kæmpe imod sin tiltrækning af Justin. Heidi melder sig til at passe naboens barn, men Spencer vil ikke have noget med børn at gøre.
programme.sub-title: Mess With Me, I Mess With You

programme.title: The Hills: Strike One
programme.desc: Kristin får sin første forsmag på at være i et forhold med Justin, da han ikke dukker op til Brodys surprise party. Heidi og Spencer er uenige om, hvornår de skal starte en familie, og Audrina går på date med Justins bedste ven.

programme.title: The Hills: Old Habits Die Hard
programme.desc: Kristin tror, at hun har tæmmet Justin, men han har måske ikke glemt Audrina. Da Holly mister kontrollen til et event, må Heidi få sin søster til at konfrontere sit spiritusproblem.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: The Fight For Georgia
programme.desc: Chloe og Sams forhold er som en rutsjebane. Max bliver træt af Stevie og finder noget sjovere et andet sted. Ankomsten af en ny eks får Georgia og Brad til at flippe skråt.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Marty The Meddler
